source.note: Every node points at a recorded model call, rule check or state change in the accepted run. This script copies them and computes no impact number.

campaign.header: The full decision network made every search and handoff visible.

methods.label: Source-linked report review
methods.sentence: Source-linked findings stayed attached to the reports that supported them.

methods.label: Temporary gap review
methods.sentence: At difficult decisions, temporary report readers and checkers followed each named gap and recorded what they found.

campaign.outcome: Across all eight runs, the network recorded which gaps triggered extra review and what each review returned.
campaign.conclusion: The unresolved paper-mill follow-up became the target for the action-card experiment.

title: How the AI team reached each rescue proposal
subtitle: One accepted production run. Every node is backed by a recorded model call, rule check, or state change.
limitation: The AI proposals never changed the real event stream. Every impact shown is modeled demand coverage, delay, or waste, computed from the sealed record.
limitation_lines: The AI proposals never changed the real event stream.
Every impact shown is modeled demand coverage, delay, or waste,
disclosure: Modeled demand, modeled coverage and modeled delay against a frozen exercise model of the public record. Never a count of people, and never a judgement of a real responder.

moments.verdict: The proposal failed the rules, so the modeled situation did not change. The proposal named a report the team was never given for this decision.

moments.situation: Hour 3.5 of 72. Yatsushiro must send crews after its emergency-call system fails.
moments.verdict: The proposal failed the rules, so the modeled situation did not change. The proposal named a report the team was never given for this decision.
moments.change: At this moment: no modeled demand was served, and no modeled unit was wasted.

moments.situation: Hour 4.5 of 72. The Governor must decide whether to ask the navy for help.
moments.verdict: The proposal passed the rules, so the modeled situation changed.
moments.change: At this moment: served coordination at the earthquake area; no modeled unit was wasted.

moments.situation: Hour 19.5 of 72. Extra water trucks must be allocated before towns ask.
moments.verdict: The proposal passed the rules, so the modeled situation changed.

moments.change: At this moment: served two safety checks: Kamiamakusa and Uki; no modeled unit was wasted.

moments.change: At this moment: no modeled demand was served, and no modeled unit was wasted.
